message.content: Baby It's You — from *Please Please Me* (1963), it appeared there before any other album.
message.reasoning_content: Please Please Me included Baby It's You and One After 909... Baby It's You appeared on Please Please Me (1963); One After 909 wasn't until Let It Be (1970). But "before any other album did" – both Baby It's You and One After 909? 909 was recorded but not released until Let It Be. So Baby It's You.
